info.name: Pioneer OPUS-QUAD
info.author: openDJ (from its XDJ-AZ mapping)
info.description: openDJ mapping for the Pioneer OPUS-QUAD in PC control (MIDI) mode: four decks, the mixer, Beat FX and Sound Color FX, hot cue pads, jog ring lights. Beta: written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list, not yet tried on the hardware.

control.description: SMART ROTARY SELECTOR - rotate - move through the list
SMART ROTARY SELECTOR +SHIFT - rotate - zoom the waveforms (openDJ)

SMART ROTARY SELECTOR - tilt down - move down the list
SMART ROTARY SELECTOR - tilt left - move to the sidebar
